The '''Maldrood sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Centares/Legends|Centares]] and [[Nizon]], both in the [[Centares system/Legends|Centares system]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Maldrood sector joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].<ref name="TEA" />

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Maldrood sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" /> However, the sector soon became the core of the [[Greater Maldrood]], an Imperial faction established by [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]].<ref name="TEA" />

When [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Zsinj]] was [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|killed]], Teradoc declared himself "High Admiral of the Mid Rim" and found himself in the middle of a [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|war]] between [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]] [[Teren Rogriss]] of the Empire and [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] of the New Republic. Teradoc was eventually [[Battle of Centares (Galactic Civil War)|defeated]] by the New Republic forces and he was forced to abandon the Greater Maldrood and flee to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="TEA" />

In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the entire sector was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] after four battles.<ref name="TEA" />
